title: 使数组按非递减顺序排列
summary: 每轮同时删除所有左邻元素严格大于自己的元素，求数组变成非递减所需轮数。
insight: 单调栈保存 [value,该元素被删除轮次]。处理 x 时弹出所有 <=x 的元素并取其最大轮次；若栈仍有更大左侧元素，x 的删除轮次为 maxPopped+1，否则永不删除为零。
pitfalls: 弹栈条件为小于等于当前值
答案是所有元素删除轮次最大值

solutions.title: 单调栈计算删除轮次
solutions.idea: 压缩所有可能在当前元素前消失的较小元素。
steps: 若 stack 非空 steps++，否则 steps=0；push 并更新 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int totalSteps(int[] nums){Deque<int[]> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();int answer=0;for(int value:nums){int steps=0;while(!stack.isEmpty()&&stack.peek()[0]<=value)steps=Math.max(steps,stack.pop()[1]);if(!stack.isEmpty())steps++;else steps=0;answer=Math.max(answer,steps);stack.push(new int[]{value,steps});}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun totalSteps(nums:IntArray):Int{val stack=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();var answer=0;for(value in nums){var steps=0;while(stack.isNotEmpty()&&stack.peek()[0]<=value)steps=maxOf(steps,stack.pop()[1]);steps=if(stack.isNotEmpty())steps+1 else 0;answer=maxOf(answer,steps);stack.push(intArrayOf(value,steps))};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int totalSteps(vector<int>& nums){vector<pair<int,int>> stack;int answer=0;for(int value:nums){int steps=0;while(!stack.empty()&&stack.back().first<=value){steps=max(steps,stack.back().second);stack.pop_back();}steps=stack.empty()?0:steps+1;answer=max(answer,steps);stack.push_back({value,steps});}return answer;} };
